exposure: Maternal plasma n-3 and n-6 PUFA concentrations at 26-28 weeks of gestation
cohort: 898 mothers and 1103 offspring in a tri-ethnic cohort in Singapore
finding: Using a Mendelian randomization approach, the study found that FADS gene variants, particularly rs174450, were associated with shorter gestation duration, suggesting a potential role of LC-PUFAs in gestation duration.
